notes.title: HEADARROW 2024 RECAP
notes.notes:
Dear HeadArrow Players and Community,

I want to take this opportunity to thank you all for everything we’ve achieved together in 2024. This year has been a true life-changer for me, as I’ve been able to dedicate myself fully to developing HeadArrow and creating unforgettable experiences with games like Doll Impostor, 8AM, The Last Stop, and many more.

I’ve prepared a short recap video featuring some of the year’s most memorable moments. While I couldn’t include every streamer who supported our games, I’ve selected some of the most famous clips from each title to celebrate how far we’ve come together. I hope you enjoy it!

[previewyoutube=0APYKN5Sfa8;full][/previewyoutube]

I’m deeply grateful to everyone who’s been there since the very beginning, offering feedback, reporting bugs, and helping our games achieve the quality they deserve. A special thanks goes to the translators of Doll Impostor, whose incredible work has brought our vision to players all over the world. I’d also like to recognize the testers and players who take the time to report issues and improve the experience for everyone. You are an essential part of our success!

This year marks the beginning of something big for HeadArrow. We are already working on at least five new launches for 2025, including more updates for Doll Impostor, spin-offs of 8AM in new settings, and entirely new titles, some in the horror genre and others in different styles. Additionally, seasonal updates for Pre-Halloween, Halloween, Pre-Christmas, and Christmas are now automated and will return every year to keep the experiences fresh.

For all these successes, and for all the ones yet to come, I thank you from the bottom of my heart. May you have a happy new year, full of fun, creativity, and new adventures! I can’t wait to continue sharing this journey with you.

With gratitude,

David Gallardo.
